notes.title: New patch live now!
notes.notes:
New MotoGP™25 patch live now!

- Improved controllers’ vibration, trigger feedback and vibration timing across all platforms.

- Revised the TCS (Traction Control System) and tyre efficiency parameters to fix the “phantom spin” issue. The handling and the feedback of the bike should now be improved overall.  

- Improvements to AI behavior on track and pit entries. Adjusted the aggressiveness of AI opponents.

- Mechanics now will install automatically the least worn tyre available.

- Team development has been recalibrated in Career mode. Inefficient development packages have been removed.

- Increased the number of teams available for negotiations during the summer break in Career mode.

- Adjusted rival rider skill tuning to better reflect the current season's performance.

- Aligned the number of laps for the Le Mans Grand Prix with real-life values in all categories.

- Updated the position of corner and braking indicators on the Balaton circuit.

- It is now possible to use the rewind feature during qualifying to attempt a final lap if the previous time is invalidated.
